title: IfcLLM: Natural Language Querying of IFC Models through Complementary Relational and Graph Representations
abstract: arXiv:2605.13236v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The Industry Foundation Classes (IFC) standard is central to building data exchange across the lifecycle, from design and construction to facility management and Digital Twin integration. In operational settings, stakeholders increasingly require access to building information without specialist knowledge of IFC's complex, deeply nested schema, motivating natural language interfaces. Existing Large Language Model (LLM)-based querying approaches typically rely on a single data representation, which is not equally suited to attribute retrieval and spatial reasoning. We present IfcLLM, a framework that combines complementary relational and graph representations, routing each query type to the more suitable backend. An LLM agent integrates both through iterative retry-and-refine reasoning, recovering from failures without user input. Evaluated on 30 query scenarios across three IFC models, the top-performing configuration achieved 96% ac

translated_title: IfcLLM：通过互补的关系型与图表示实现对IFC模型的自然语言查询
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.13236v3 公告类型：替换。摘要：行业基础类（IFC）标准是建筑数据在全生命周期（从设计与施工到设施管理及数字孪生集成）中交换的核心。在实际运营场景中，利益相关方越来越需要在不具备IFC复杂、深度嵌套模式的专业知识的情况下获取建筑信息，这催生了对自然语言界面的需求。现有基于大语言模型（LLM）的查询方法通常依赖单一的数据表示，而单一表示无法同时很好地胜任属性检索和空间推理两类任务。我们提出了IfcLLM，一个结合互补的关系型与图两种表示的框架，可将每种查询类型路由到更合适的后端。LLM智能体通过迭代的“重试-精炼”推理将两者整合，无需用户干预即可从失败中恢复。在三个IFC模型共30个查询场景上的评估中，表现最佳的配置达到了96%的准确率。
tldr: IfcLLM提出将关系型与图两种互补数据表示相结合的框架，通过LLM智能体的迭代重试-精炼推理自动将自然语言查询路由到最合适的后端，在IFC模型查询任务中达到96%的准确率，且无需用户干预即可从失败中自动恢复。
en_tdlr: IfcLLM combines complementary relational and graph representations, using an LLM agent to route each natural language query to the suitable backend and iteratively retry-and-refine to recover from failures, achieving 96% accuracy on querying IFC models.
